trait_realm_08_kuinie_info: Observing the gate of Nirvana, mind begins to settle.
trait_realm_09_jingnie_info: Nirvana fire cleanses the body, pure and flawless.
trait_realm_10_suinie_info: Break and stand, reborn through Nirvana.
trait_realm_11_kongnie_info: Insight into emptiness, Nirvana becomes formless.
trait_realm_12_kongling_info: Spirit platform is clear, merging with the Dao.
trait_realm_13_kongxuan_info: Mysterious and profound, the gateway to all wonders.

trait_attr_01_metal_info: Metal is solemn and killing, sharp and solid.
trait_attr_02_wood_info: Wood is growth, extending and long.
trait_attr_03_water_info: Water nourishes downwards, merging and soft.
trait_attr_04_fire_info: Fire flames upwards, fierce and bright.
trait_attr_05_earth_info: Earth carries weight, transforming and completing.
trait_path_01_demonic_info: Proving Dao through demons, acting against the current.
trait_path_03_beast_info: Body of a beast, merging with heaven and earth.
trait_path_04_ancient_info: Inheriting Ancient God Dao, casting an indestructible body.
trait_intent_02_angel_info: Angel (Guardian): Range 10 Group Heal + Higher DMG reduction with more allies.
trait_intent_03_qianhuan_info: Illusions: Combat start, hit stacks +5% DMG (≤5, lasts 5s), Base Accuracy +15%.
trait_intent_04_killing_info: Bloodlust: +10% Final DMG at combat start; Kills add stacks, -1 stack/sec after 10s out of combat.
trait_intent_05_reverse_info: Reversal: Clear 1 debuff every 5s & gain +20% ATK for 5s.
trait_intent_06_life_death_info: Life/Death: Passive +20% Max HP; Combat phase 40% DMG Reduc + 30% Vamp.
trait_intent_07_reincarnation_info: Lifeguard: Passive death prevention, heal & invincible. 300yr CD.
trait_intent_08_chaos_info: Chaos: Combat start, 15% chance for 300% DMG or Self-Heal 10%.
trait_intent_01_extreme_info: Instantly execute same/lower realm on hit (Cannot reach Soul Formation in this life).
trait_divine_02_weiya_info: If enemy cultivator (ineffective vs Ancient Gods) is lower realm by 1 stage, they are immobilized.
trait_divine_01_baonuzhibian_info: Instantly heal 60% HP, +150% ATK for 60s; Costs 150 lifespan per use.
trait_divine_04_wanjianguizong_info: Summon flying sword storm, causes bleeding.
trait_divine_06_zhenkongquan_info: Release 6 tiles forward, causes damage & knockback 2 tiles, slows.
trait_divine_07_jiuyinbaiguzhao_info: Melee instant claw, executes 15% HP and prevents healing.
trait_divine_09_jianzhan_info: Summon an Immortal Sword from the heavens for a slash.
trait_art_01_missile_info: Refines vengeful souls. Hits prevent healing and deal extreme Dark burst damage.
trait_art_02_ascension_info: Burns Vital Energy to force cultivation rise. Vastly buffs ATK, DEF, Regen. Stuns/Scares lower realm enemies on cast.
trait_art_03_slash_info: Turns into afterimages for high-speed AOE slashes. Untargetable/Invincible during cast. Converts damage dealt to HP.
trait_art_04_quake_info: Infuses energy to cause a massive quake. Stuns ground units and deals devastating damage to buildings.
trait_art_05_waves_info: Summons black waves of demonic power forward. Each wave knocks back enemies and deals increasing damage.
trait_art_06_convert_info: Life/Death conversion. Deals burst damage to enemy, then instantly heals self and allies for that amount, cleansing debuffs.
trait_art_07_palm_info: Golden giant palm falls from sky. Suppresses area enemies (immobilize), destroys projectiles, deals True Damage.
trait_art_08_breaker_info: Condensed point of energy. Pierces armor. If target is a cultivator, disorders their Qi, greatly reducing all stats.
trait_art_09_shield_info: Visible energy shield. Greatly reduces incoming damage, reflects melee attacks, grants immunity to knockback/control.
trait_art_10_link_info: Links divine souls. Shares damage received. Blessings and misfortunes shared, live and die together.

xn_treasure_hunfan_description: Ancient tool that uses souls as a banner to suppress spirits.
xn_treasure_qingtong_jian_description: Ancient bronze sword, sharp but unassuming.
xn_treasure_zijin_hulu_description: Can contain all things. Reveal power after refining.
xn_treasure_pangu_fu_description: Mountain-splitting tool, heavy as the ocean.
xn_treasure_qingguang_dun_description: Protects with clear light against edges and spells.
xn_treasure_tianni_zhu_description: Bead that defies heavenly secrets. Void Class.
xn_treasure_xianyu_baota_description: Exquisite pagoda, seals layer by layer. Void Class.
xn_treasure_mieshen_mao_description: Spear that breaks gods and souls. Void Class.
xn_treasure_liguang_gong_description: Bow opens like a full moon, arrows like meteors. Void Class.
xn_treasure_xiuxing_zhixin_description: Heart of a star, nurturing all things. Void Class.
xn_treasure_desc_hunfan: Treasure of the Soul Refining Sect. Contains a billion vengeful souls. Waving it causes wailing ghosts to cover the sun. Consumes living souls to grow, corrupts enemy treasures. A demonic weapon of the stars.
xn_treasure_desc_qingtong_jian: A simple ancient bronze sword, rusty but unmatched in sharpness. Engraved with ancient runes, it can break restrictions and teleport to kill enemies.
xn_treasure_desc_zijin_hulu: Purple Gold Gourd with strange powers, containing a universe inside. Can collect all living things and refine spiritual energy into pills.
xn_treasure_desc_pangu_fu: Heavy treasure of ultimate strength. One swing splits mountains, creating shockwaves. Usable only by those with immense physical strength.
xn_treasure_desc_qingguang_dun: Defensive treasure emitting azure light. When activated, creates an indestructible light curtain blocking attacks from all sides.
xn_treasure_desc_tianni_zhu: Item of defying fate, containing a space of five elements and time dilation. The starting point of the heaven-defying path and key to Trampling Heaven.
xn_treasure_desc_xianyu_baota: Pagoda made of supreme Immortal Jade. Multiple layers to suppress strong enemies or protect the user from heavy blows.
xn_treasure_desc_mieshen_mao: Companion weapon of the Ancient Gods, holding their wrath. One thrust shatters the starry sky, specialized in breaking Primordial Spirits and bodies.
xn_treasure_desc_liguang_gong: Legendary bow of Li Guang. Requires immense physical strength to draw. Arrows fly like dragons, never returning without blood. A weapon for long-range killing.
xn_treasure_desc_xiuxing_zhixin: Core of a Cultivation Planet. Only Step 2 cultivators can refine it. Merging with it allows controlling the planet's power to suppress enemies.

cultivation_history_system_prompt:
You are a professional cultivation (Renegade Immortal) novelist. Based on the provided character data, write a short cultivation-history story.
Requirements:
1. Keep it between 50 and 550 words
2. The story should have a beginning, development, turn, and conclusion, including cultivation, breakthroughs, trials, and wandering experience
3. Use the character's realm, traits, experiences, and other data to weave a plausible plot
4. Use vivid, flavorful language that fits a cultivation novel
5. Make the story complete and leave no unresolved suspense
6. Do not repeat the raw character data; weave it naturally into the story
